statements.subject: state_machine
statements.description: Event 1: ManualStart - Local system administrator manually starts the peer connection. Status: Mandatory. The PassiveTcpEstablishment attribute SHOULD be set to FALSE.

statements.subject: state_machine
statements.description: Event 2: ManualStop - Local system administrator manually stops the peer connection. Status: Mandatory. No interaction with any optional attributes.

statements.subject: state_machine
statements.description: Event 3: AutomaticStart - Local system automatically starts the BGP connection. Status: Optional. AllowAutomaticStart SHOULD be TRUE, PassiveTcpEstablishment SHOULD be FALSE, DampPeerOscillations SHOULD be FALSE.
statements.pre_cond: session.AllowAutomaticStart = TRUE & session.PassiveTcpEstablishment = FALSE & session.DampPeerOscillations = FALSE

statements.subject: state_machine
statements.description: Event 4: ManualStart_with_PassiveTcpEstablishment - Local system administrator manually starts the peer connection with PassiveTcpEstablishment enabled. Status: Optional. PassiveTcpEstablishment SHOULD be TRUE, DampPeerOscillations SHOULD be FALSE.

statements.subject: state_machine
statements.description: Event 5: AutomaticStart_with_PassiveTcpEstablishment - Local system automatically starts the BGP connection with PassiveTcpEstablishment enabled. Status: Optional. AllowAutomaticStart SHOULD be TRUE, PassiveTcpEstablishment SHOULD be TRUE, DampPeerOscillations SHOULD be FALSE.
statements.pre_cond: session.AllowAutomaticStart = TRUE & session.PassiveTcpEstablishment = TRUE & session.DampPeerOscillations = FALSE

statements.subject: state_machine
statements.description: Event 6: AutomaticStart_with_DampPeerOscillations - Local system automatically starts the BGP peer connection with peer oscillation damping enabled. Status: Optional. AllowAutomaticStart SHOULD be TRUE, DampPeerOscillations SHOULD be TRUE, PassiveTcpEstablishment SHOULD be FALSE.
statements.pre_cond: session.AllowAutomaticStart = TRUE & session.DampPeerOscillations = TRUE & session.PassiveTcpEstablishment = FALSE

statements.subject: state_machine
statements.description: Event 7: AutomaticStart_with_DampPeerOscillations_and_PassiveTcpEstablishment - Local system automatically starts the BGP peer connection with peer oscillation damping and PassiveTcpEstablishment enabled. Status: Optional. AllowAutomaticStart SHOULD be TRUE, DampPeerOscillations SHOULD be TRUE, PassiveTcpEstablishment SHOULD be TRUE.
statements.pre_cond: session.AllowAutomaticStart = TRUE & session.DampPeerOscillations = TRUE & session.PassiveTcpEstablishment = TRUE

statements.subject: state_machine
statements.description: Event 8: AutomaticStop - Local system automatically stops the BGP connection. Status: Optional. AllowAutomaticStop SHOULD be TRUE.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The PassiveTcpEstablishment attribute SHOULD be set to FALSE when Event 1 (ManualStart) is generated.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The AllowAutomaticStart attribute SHOULD be set to TRUE when any of Event 3, 5, 6, or 7 (automatic start events) occur.
statements.guard_semantics: event = AutomaticStart | event = AutomaticStart_with_PassiveTcpEstablishment | event = AutomaticStart_with_DampPeerOscillations | event = AutomaticStart_with_DampPeerOscillations_and_PassiveTcpEstablishment

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The AllowAutomaticStop attribute SHOULD be TRUE when Event 8 (AutomaticStop) occurs.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: The DampPeerOscillations attribute SHOULD be set to TRUE when Event 6 (AutomaticStart_with_DampPeerOscillations) or Event 7 (AutomaticStart_with_DampPeerOscillations_and_PassiveTcpEstablishment) occurs.
